raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Complete PR 8 of #49569: fix the remaining type errors in the model test subdirectories and enforce `follow_imports=silent` for all eight directories.

## Claims

- Fix the type errors in `tests/models/{kimi_k3,transformers,qwen4_exp,inkling,minimax_m3}` with type narrowing, corrected helper annotations, and typed test setup.
- Add all five directories plus the already-clean `glm5next`, `step5`, and `deepseek_v32` directories to `SILENT_GROUPS`.
- Preserve the existing test cases and numerical checks. Changes are limited to tests and mypy routing.

## Validation

Using the pinned mypy 1.20.2 toolchain, Python target 3.11, and the pre-commit hook's dependencies:

- Original baseline at `0eea5aca8`: **96 errors in 21 files**. With this change rebased onto `e96b490b1`: **75 source files, no issues**, with `--warn-unused-ignores`.
- Full-repository mypy hook and all applicable pre-commit hooks on changed files: passed.
- CPU test selection: **166 passed, 2 skipped**.
- `group_files()` routes all 75 files to `''`; the remaining parent directories retain their separate groups.

CUDA/ROCm and multi-GPU tests were not run locally. Additional suites could not be collected because this environment lacks `flydsl` or `ray`. Existing Buildkite jobs cover the affected model suites.

<details>
<summary>Validation commands</summary>

For the focused mypy command, `MYPY_PYTHON` points to the Python executable in pre-commit's mypy environment, so dependency types match CI.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m mypy --python-executable "$MYPY_PYTHON" \
  --python-version 3.11 --follow-imports silent --warn-unused-ignores \
  tests/models/kimi_k3 tests/models/transformers tests/models/qwen4_exp \
  tests/models/inkling tests/models/minimax_m3 tests/models/glm5next \
  tests/models/step5 tests/models/deepseek_v32

.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run mypy --all-files
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run  # with the PR changes staged

HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/models/inkling/test_contract_validation.py \
  tests/models/kimi_k3/test_eagle3.py \
  tests/models/kimi_k3/test_sequence_parallel.py \
  tests/models/kimi_k3/amd_specialized_decode/test_runtime.py \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_linear.py::test_glu_identifies_down_projection \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_linear.py::test_qkv_identifies_output_projection \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_linear.py::test_fuser_is_cached_per_class_and_structure \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_linear.py::test_weight_mappings_are_scoped_to_fused_prefixes \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_moe.py \
  tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_rms_norm.py \
  tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py::test_attention_layer_index_is_the_modules_own \
  tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_ple.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py \
  -k '(not test_ple and not test_qsa_reference) or (test_ple_metadata_preserves_request_and_token_order and cpu) or test_clearing_qsa_key_cache_releases_its_storage' -q
```

</details>

## Details

These directories previously inherited `follow_imports=skip` from the parent test group. Adding them to `SILENT_GROUPS` makes the fixes enforced in CI and checks future additions too. A few error-specific ignores remain at intentional test-double and platform-import boundaries; unused-ignore checking passes.

Checked #49569's discussion and open mypy PRs before opening this draft. #62891 covers the later parent-directory rollup and #63008 covers KV connector tests; neither implements this PR 8 scope.

AI assistance: used OpenAI Codex to help implement the type fixes and run validation.

---

</details>
